atAGlance: Nước khoáng không ga is still mineral water, clean and bubble-free, with không ga telling you there is no fizz.
whatItIs: Nước khoáng không ga is non-carbonated mineral water. Expect still mineral water with no bubbles and a clean finish.
howToEnjoy: Use không ga when you want mineral water without fizz.
howLocalsOrder: Order nước khoáng không ga when you want still mineral water. Ask for a cold sealed bottle and no ice if you prefer it plain.
worthKnowing: On Vietnamese drink menus, không ga is the still-water cue, useful when a place has both sparkling and non-sparkling mineral water.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước khoáng không ga.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bottle of still mineral water.
